expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the integrator milestone with TODOs; no full engine
expectations.evidence: Scaffolded only milestone 1/7 ('Where we are: milestone 1/7 — the integrator') with the physics left as learner TODOs: body.js has 'TODO 1' (invMass), 'TODO 2: accumulate into this.force', 'TODO 3' (integrate); world.js has 'TODO 4: implement the accumulator loop' and 'TODO 5'. expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with concrete command and expected behaviour: 'How to check it: cd physics-engine && node --test' plus 'Right now it's 2 pass / 3 fail. Done means 5 pass — the tests pin the physics (free fall 1 s → 0.5·g within 1%), the step count (exactly 120 per simulated second), remainder carry-over, static bodies, and spike clamping.'

expectations.text: B3: Mentions a fixed timestep and an integrator such as semi-implicit Euler
expectations.evidence: Explicitly covers both: '**Semi-implicit Euler** — update velocity first, then position with the *new* velocity... a = F/m + g, then v += a·dt, then x += v·dt' and '**Fixed timestep with an accumulator** — ...run as many fixed dt = 1/120 s steps as the bank covers, carrying the remainder to the next frame.'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 4 shell commands are version checks/test runs ('node --version... ls -la', 'cd physics-engine && node --test ...'), no install commands; all writes/edits are inside physics-engine/ (package.json, README.md, PROGRESS.md, src/*, tests/m1.test.js).
